post_result_analysis: Actor grad norm stays ~44 (always clipped to 1.0) while the PPO surrogate is ~1e-3 and PPO clipping is almost inactive. In cosmos_framework/posttrain/model/gr00t/ppo.py:_features/_values the value head consumes vl_self_attention(vlln(...)) and state_encoder(...), which belong to the actor parameter partition (policy.py PPOParameterPartition: every trainable not under action_head.value_head). Value-regression gradients therefore update the shared actor trunk at the actor lr, consistent with reward-independent policy drift.
